title: Optimize Console: staged diffs, safe apply/rollback, and immutable audit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a user-friendly, auditable workflow in the Optimize section of the Console that surfaces batching and KV-caching recommendations, shows safe diffs before applying config changes, supports staged canary applies and rollbacks, and records an immutable audit ledger for every change. The feature is for customers on Redwood Hosted and Dedicated who use Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token costs while preserving latency SLOs. Current pain: engineers view recommendations but have no standard way to preview exact config diffs, test changes safely, or trace who applied/rolled back changes and why. This results in manual change management, support load, and missed savings.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Recommendation cards exist in Optimize list and detail views with clear estimated cost delta, confidence, and required config changes (human-readable and machine diff).
2) Clicking 'Preview diff' shows a side-by-side machine-readable diff and a short natural-language summary of what will change (batch size, cache TTLs, quantization profile).
3) 'Staged apply' mode allows selecting scope (single route, model, or account), percentage rollout, and health checks (latency/error windows).
4) Console records an immutable audit entry for every preview/apply/rollback, capturing user, timestamp, prior and new configs (hashed), and optional reasoning note.
5) Rollback button is available for 24h after apply, with automated safety checks before execution.
6) UX supports linking to a live canary dashboard and to the underlying PR/Runbook.
7) End-to-end tests and manual QA pass for Hosted and Dedicated console variants.
implementation_notes: Frontend: new RecommendationCard component, DiffPreview modal, StagedApply wizard, and AuditTimeline view. Use existing Console patterns for toasts, modals, and canary config. Backend: API endpoints: GET /optimize/recs, POST /optimize/recs/:id/apply (with scope, rollout_percent, health_checks), POST /optimize/recs/:id/rollback, GET /optimize/audit?rec_id=. Store immutable audit entries in audit store (append-only) with payloads hashed for PII minimization. Instrument events for analytics: rec_preview, rec_apply_started, rec_apply_completed, rec_rollback. Add authorization checks: only roles with 'optimize.applicant' may apply. Implement feature flag to flip behavior per-customer. Coordinate with Dedicated control plane for private deployments to surface same audit trail via VPC-compatible endpoints.
risks: Large-scale applies could inadvertently increase latency if batching/tuning is aggressive
Audit must not leak customer secrets (ensure hashing and redaction)
Dedicated customers have different upgrade windows — ensure rollback mechanism works with reserved capacity policies
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal dogfood behind feature flag for Redwood teams (2 weeks). Phase 2: opt-in beta for 10 customers (mix of Hosted+Dedic) with engineer support and a playbook (3 weeks). Phase 3: gradual enable for free-tier recommendations with opt-out and telemetry gating; full GA after 6 weeks of stable metrics. Provide playbook, runbook, and customer communications. Post-release: 24/7 on-call for first week for apply/rollback incidents.
metrics: % of recommendations applied via staged apply vs manual
median time to rollback after a failed apply
average cost savings (applied recommendations) per account
false-positive rate where applied recs increased token cost or latency
qa_checks: Preview diffs match backend-generated config changes
Staged apply honors rollout percentage and scope
Rollback restores prior hashed config entry and triggers audit log
Audit entries are immutable and queryable by rec_id, user, and time window
Security review for audit content confirmed (no unredacted secrets)
